boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named stops along Lake Michigan Drive and its 48th Avenue gateway, each with one practical, directly sourced reason to go.

cards.title: Borrow Beyond Campus
cards.subtitle: Library Lane, off the Lake Michigan Drive corridor
cards.notes: Bring your library card and browse the Library of Things for equipment and activities that extend beyond books.
cards.short_summary: A public-library stop for borrowing books and useful objects.
cards.evidence_claim: The library is at 6175 Library Lane and its official site features a Library of Things alongside its catalog and programs.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists Monday–Thursday evening service, with hours varying by day; confirm the calendar before visiting.

cards.title: Choose Your Court
cards.subtitle: Lake Michigan Drive civic corridor
cards.notes: Bring a ball or racquet and choose among the basketball, tennis, and pickleball courts listed by the township.
cards.short_summary: A 40-acre recreation stop with courts, fields, and play areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Allendale Township places the 40-acre park at 6676 Lake Michigan Drive and lists ballfields, courts, a playground, fitness area, shelters, and a bandstand.
cards.access_notes: The township says the seasonal splash pad operates 9 a.m.–7 p.m. from the week before Memorial Day through the week after Labor Day.

cards.title: Pick Up a Grinder
cards.subtitle: Lake Michigan Drive opposite GVSU
cards.notes: Cross Lake Michigan Drive for a grinder made with bread the restaurant says it bakes in-house each day.
cards.short_summary: A campus-facing restaurant centered on baked grinders and pizza.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant identifies itself as locally owned, located on Lake Michigan Drive directly across from GVSU, and serving grinders made with bread baked in-house daily.
cards.access_notes: The official site confirms dine-in seating; check its current service information before leaving campus.

cards.title: Use the Campus-ID Offer
cards.subtitle: 5065 Lake Michigan Drive corridor
cards.notes: Bring a valid GVSU ID if ordering; the location page currently advertises a student-and-staff discount.
cards.short_summary: A pizza stop with a documented GVSU identification offer.
cards.evidence_claim: Peppino's official Allendale page lists 5065 Lake Michigan Drive and advertises 10% off for GVSU students and staff with valid identification.
cards.source_title: Allendale MI Sports Grille | Peppino’s in Allendale, MI
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists dine-in and carryout, plus daily operating hours; verify them before visiting.

cards.title: Order a Lettuce-Wrap Option
cards.subtitle: Lake Michigan Drive at the 48th Avenue gateway
cards.notes: Choose pickup or indoor seating, and use the documented Unwich lettuce-wrap substitution if bread is not your plan.
cards.short_summary: A sandwich counter with pickup, delivery, seating, and lettuce wraps.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John's lists store 0677 at 4814 Lake Michigan Drive, confirms indoor seating, and says sandwiches can be made as Unwich lettuce wraps.
cards.source_title: Sandwich Shop & Gourmet Subs in Allendale | Jimmy John's 0677
cards.access_notes: The location page lists dine-in hours through 10 p.m. daily and separate delivery hours; confirm current hours before travel.

cards.title: Check the Flavor Calendar
cards.subtitle: 5128 Lake Michigan Drive corridor
cards.notes: Open the location's calendar before heading out and match your visit to the posted rotating Flavor of the Day.
cards.short_summary: A frozen-custard stop with a location-specific flavor schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Culver's official page places the restaurant at 5128 Lake Michigan Drive NW and publishes a dated Flavor of the Day calendar for this location.
cards.source_title: Culver's of Allendale, MI – Lake Michigan Dr
cards.access_notes: The official page lists separate lobby, curbside, and drive-through hours; check the live page for the day's schedule.

cards.title: Build a Carryout Order
cards.subtitle: 5164 Lake Michigan Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use the location page to build a pizza, sandwich, pasta, salad, or dessert order for pickup near campus.
cards.short_summary: A carryout and delivery counter with a broad online menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official store page lists 5164 Lake Michigan Drive, Suite A, and offers online ordering for pizza, breads, chicken, pasta, sandwiches, desserts, salads, and drinks.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 5164 Lake Michigan Dr Suite A | Domino's in Allendale
cards.access_notes: The official page offers delivery and carryout; use its live hours display before placing or collecting an order.

cards.title: Pause at the Campus Gateway
cards.subtitle: Lake Michigan Drive and 48th Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Stop at the southwest corner of Lake Michigan Drive and 48th Avenue for coffee, tea, or another café drink.
cards.short_summary: A coffee counter positioned at the principal road junction by campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Allendale Area Chamber page lists BIGGBY Coffee at 4814 Lake Michigan Drive, Suite 500, near GVSU on the southwest corner of 48th Avenue.
cards.source_title: BIGGBY COFFEE of Allendale | Allendale Area Chamber of Commerce
cards.access_notes: The chamber listing publishes daily hours, but consult the business's live location information before visiting.

cards.title: Choose a Treat-Only Stop
cards.subtitle: 5053 Lake Michigan Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use this location specifically for a Blizzard, cone, shake, parfait, or custom cake; it is classified as Treat Only.
cards.short_summary: A dessert-focused Dairy Queen and Orange Julius location.
cards.evidence_claim: Dairy Queen's official page identifies the store at 5053 Lake Michigan Drive, Suite A, as a Treat Only DQ/Orange Julius and lists cakes and frozen treats.
cards.source_title: DQ Treat Only in Allendale, MI | DairyQueen.com
cards.access_notes: The official page lists store, delivery, and drive-through schedules separately; verify the live hours before going.

cards.title: Restock the Pantry
cards.subtitle: 6370 Lake Michigan Drive corridor
cards.notes: Make a practical grocery run and check the official weekly ad or online-shopping link before building your list.
cards.short_summary: A full grocery stop with online shopping and an on-site pharmacy.
cards.evidence_claim: Family Fare's official store page lists the Allendale market at 6370 Lake Michigan Drive, Suite 100, with grocery services, online shopping, a weekly ad, and pharmacy hours.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists the grocery store open daily from 6 a.m. to midnight, with shorter pharmacy hours.
